none: PAS NLM-884E66: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Brookenby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Sam Moorhead kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.6mm, Weight: 1.95gms, die axis: 6
